title: Habitat/dispersal determinism hygiene (§4.48)
simLoop: habitatProcess declares the terrain and soil-material fields it reads; runHerbEstablishmentStep no longer reads a sibling guild's same-tick result (every cross-guild biomass read moved into the non-mutating runDispersalStep); strand/binder/marsh/shrub/crust HSI is computed once per dispersal tick and cached, not recomputed a second time at a different cadence inside establishment.
gameLoop: No player-visible change in verbs or controls — this is scheduler/read-declaration and code-dedup hygiene. The establishment probability shown in the field notebook / inspector now always matches the HSI that actually drove that season's growth.
notebookSeed: What the inspector says a patch needs, and what actually grew there this season, used to have two separate sources of truth. Now they're the same number.
tierO: no owner-only question — declared-reads coverage and update-order commutativity are CI-judged (habitatDispersalHygiene.test.ts). No new Process; D-007 clip gate does not apply.
